answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch on the ridge unless refreshed by genuine work, drying up like a flower starved of nectar. A fake farm can flash to the horizon for a moment, but every idle clone's weight thins the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding bill.
